title: Lauryn Hill And Rohan Marley's 16-Year-Old Daughter Celebrates Senior Day With Rare Photos And Video - Blavity
text:
Rohan Marley and Lauryn Hill are celebrating a special time for their 16-year-old daughter, Sara. In a heartwarming Instagram video he shared on Thursday, Marley paid tribute to Sara during her senior day.
“Let’s Go @whoissaramarley Senior Day has come ‘ wow … It’s been so beautiful watching you progress , college our next stop .. Daddy’s Girl. Sara said she going for the Hat-Trick. 3 sport varsity athlete all 4 years,” Marley captioned his Instagram post.
Rohan continued to show love to his daughter when he posted another video of the family coming together for Sara’s senior day.
“So much good family time tonight ‘ watching Our Princess Sara @whoissaramarley Senior Night Awesome Goal ⚽️‘We Love You So Much ‘ Your Super Proud Parents ❤️❤️❤️Blessed Love Queen @mslaurynhill,” the proud dad wrote.
Lauryn Hill and her daughter, Sara, visited Johannesburg in 2024
The latest special moment of Sara’s senior year comes after she took a trip to Johannesburg, South Africa with Hill earlier this year, per BCK Online. In Johannesburg, the mother-and-daughter duo visited McBain Charles Primary School, where they donated school supplies and shoes to students.
“Before she left, she read and danced with the students who also sang songs for her. It looked like an all around special time! Sara also visited with some of the older students who are learning a trade, in this case sewing and garment construction and actually make the school uniforms!” Hill wrote at that time, per BCK.
The proud mother also said her daughter became inspired to start a non-profit after the trip.
“Sara left inspired, fired-up, and determined to start her own non-profit org in order to spread more sunshine wherever she can!” Hill added.
How many children do Lauryn Hill and Rohan Marley share together?
They are the proud parents of five children; their children are Zion, Selah, John, Sara and Joshua, also known as YG Marley. Hill is also the mother of a sixth child, Micah, who was born in 2011. Micah’s father is unknown.
